entries.prompt: A warm, intimate reverb — like playing guitar alone in a small wooden cabin at night
Gritty tape-saturated overdrive — the sound of a cassette recorder being pushed too hard
Slow shimmering tremolo — a candle flame flickering in a quiet room
Deep sub-bass chorus — thick and syrupy, like bass strings under water
Frosted glass distortion with cyberpunk chromatic aberration
Warm vintage film grain with soft vignette — an old Super 8 home movie
Glitchy RGB pixel sort with horizontal scanline tears — a corrupted broadcast signal
Telephone effect — narrow band-pass filter making voice sound like an old phone call
Soft dreamy blur — like memories fading at the edge of sleep
Hard digital bitcrusher — 8-bit retro destruction, like a Game Boy running out of battery
Pencil sketch outline — Sobel edge detection making the scene look hand-drawn
Rippling water surface — animated sine distortion like sunlight through a shallow pool
